description: Phone photo to clean dewarped scan (UVDoc + OpenCV, CPU).
fullDescription:
## OVERVIEW ##
Turns a phone photo of a document into a clean, dewarped, scanner-quality image — entirely locally, on CPU, in ~1-2 s/page.

Pipeline: UVDoc geometric dewarp (straight lines, no perspective) followed by OpenCV cleanup (illumination flatten, local contrast, sharpen, level stretch, edge-protected stain removal). Pixels are never regenerated.

REST API (FastAPI): POST /scan (image), /scan/json (base64), /scan/pdf (multi-page). Every step is toggleable and tunable via DOCSCANNER_* env.
